name: computer
description: computer use: you can drive the user's own browser (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Arc) in background tabs of your own tab group, with his logins (open pages, read them, click, type, fill forms, take screenshots), and control his Mac apps (Notes, TextEdit, Figma...) through Accessibility, without taking his screen or his active tab. Use it when the user says computer use, or when a task needs to see or act in a web page, a tab or an app; /computer-use sets it up

dev.bise.tagline: an agent uses your browser and Mac apps
prompts: open my last Gmail tab and sum up the thread
fill the form in my open tab from my notes, don't submit it
check bise.dev in my browser and tell me what looks broken
